email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – course video playback
email.body_text:
Hi Meera,

Thank you for your time on our call, and I am sorry for the trouble.

Your next steps:
1. Ask one of your affected students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

What we'll do next:

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-03

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
